data.gender_notes: Hilahtun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hilahtun is an Arabic name that means 'gentle flower'. This name symbolizes the gentle and calm nature of a flower, which can bring peace and tranquility to those around it. The name Hilahtun carries the meaning “Gentle flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hilahtun usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hilahtun is a name that embodies the gentle and calming presence of nature. It is a reminder to be gentle and compassionate in our interactions with others and the world around us.
data.etymology: Hilahtun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hilahtun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
